title: A car crash
description: A dialogue lesson on the present perfect and past simple tenses. Mr. Wood goes to the garage to collect his car, but the attendant says the mechanics are still working on it. In the garage they discover Mr. Wood's car has crashed into a lamp-post — the attendant tells him that he needs a new car. Workbook practice covers a fill-in-the-blank dialogue and a vocabulary exercise. Grammar exercises practise past tense/past participle forms, asking and answering 'Have you done it yet?' questions, answering 'Have they stopped?' questions, and completing dialogues with present-perfect questions and past-simple answers.
answer_note: Lesson listening question (Can the mechanics repair Mr. Wood's car?) is a suggested model answer based on the dialogue. Practice A (fill in the dialogue) 23 blanks are taken from the supplied Lesson 87 key (img/key-085-090.jpg). Practice B (vocabulary) 7 items are taken from the same key. Grammar I (write past tense and past participle) 10 items are taken from the grammar key (PDF viewer page 502). Grammar II (ask and answer questions) item 1 is a printed example; items 2-12 are suggested model answers following the example pattern. Grammar III (answer questions) item 1 is a printed example; items 2-6 are suggested model answers following the example pattern. Grammar IV (complete dialogues) item 1 is a printed example; items 2-10 are suggested model answers following the example pattern. No external sources were used.

lesson.text:
Listen then answer this question.
Can the mechanics repair Mr. Wood's car?
听录音，然后回答问题。修理工能否修复伍德先生的汽车？
lesson.translation: Listen to the recording, then answer: Can the mechanics repair Mr. Wood's car?

lines.speaker: MR. WOOD
lines.translation: 伍德先生：我的汽车修好了吗？

lines.speaker: ATTENDANT
lines.text:
I don't know, sir.
What's the number
of your car?
lines.translation: 服务员：我不知道，先生。您的汽车牌号是多少？

lines.speaker: ATTENDANT
lines.text: When did you bring it to us?
lines.translation: 服务员：您什么时候送来的？

lines.speaker: MR. WOOD
lines.text: I brought it here three days ago.

lines.speaker: ATTENDANT
lines.translation: 服务员：啊，是的，我现在记起来了。

lines.speaker: MR. WOOD
lines.translation: 伍德先生：你们的机械师修好了吗？

lines.speaker: ATTENDANT
lines.text:
No, they're still working on it.
Let's go into the garage
and have a look at it.
lines.translation: 服务员：没有，他们还在修呢。我们到车库去看一下吧。

lines.speaker: ATTENDANT
lines.translation: 服务员：这不是您的车吗？

lines.speaker: MR. WOOD
lines.translation: 伍德先生：唔，这曾是我的车。

lines.speaker: ATTENDANT
lines.translation: 服务员：您不是出车祸了吧？

lines.speaker: MR. WOOD
lines.text:
That's right.
I drove it into a lamp-post.
Can your mechanics repair it?
lines.translation: 伍德先生：是啊。我把汽车撞在路灯柱上了。你们的机械师能修好吗？

lines.speaker: ATTENDANT
lines.text:
Well,
they're trying to repair it, sir.
But to tell you the truth,
you need a new car!
lines.translation: 服务员：啊，他们正设法修呢，先生。不过说实在的，您需要一辆新车了！

lesson.title: Listening — answer the question
lesson.instruction: Listen then answer this question. Can the mechanics repair Mr. Wood's car? 听录音，然后回答问题。修理工能否修复伍德先生的汽车？
lesson.translation: Answer the question according to the dialogue.

questions.prompt: Can the mechanics repair Mr. Wood's car?
questions.answer: No, they can't. He needs a new car.

items.text: 在英文中可以用一般疑问句的否定形式来表示期待、请求或希望得到肯定的答复，如课文中的 Isn't that your car? 和 Didn't you have a crash?

Well, it was my car.
well 是感叹词。在这里表示“哎”。was 用斜体，表示“过去是，现在不是了”。was 要重读。
drive into 是“撞到……”的意思。
they're trying to repair it, 他们正在设法修理。try 后面常接 to + 动词不定式。

practice.title: B — Vocabulary
practice.instruction:
Choose and write in the correct word. 选词填空。

1. Can you ______ your car into the garage here next week, sir? (take / bring)
2. To ______ you the truth, I haven't finished the work yet. (say / tell)
3. The man is ______ trying to repair my bicycle. (still / yet)
4. The dentist ______ a look at Mr. Croft's teeth. (looked / had)
5. The garage ______ is looking at my car now. (assistant / attendant)
6. The girl ______ her bicycle into a tree. (drove / rode)
7. A car hit my bicycle. Can you ______ it for me? (repair / try)

grammar.title: II. Ask and answer questions according to the example. 仿照例句提问并回答。
grammar.instruction:
Ask and answer questions according to the example. 仿照例句提问并回答。
Example: 1. You started to do your homework an hour ago. → Have you done it yet? No, I haven't. I'm still doing it.
grammar.translation: Write a present-perfect question and a negative answer for each statement, following the example.
grammar.context: Item 1 is a printed example (not editable). Items 2-12 are suggested model answers following the example pattern.

questions.prompt: 1. You started to do your homework an hour ago.
questions.answer: Have you done it yet? / No, I haven't. I'm still doing it.

questions.prompt: 2. He started to make a bookcase yesterday.
questions.answer: Has he made a bookcase yet? / No, he hasn't. He's still making it.

questions.prompt: 3. You started to wash the dishes five minutes ago.
questions.answer: Have you washed the dishes yet? / No, I haven't. I'm still washing them.

questions.prompt: 4. He started to paint the chairs two days ago.
questions.answer: Has he painted the chairs yet? / No, he hasn't. He's still painting them.

questions.prompt: 5. They started to have dinner at six o'clock.
questions.answer: Have they had dinner yet? / No, they haven't. They're still having it.

questions.prompt: 6. You started to repair the table twenty minutes ago.
questions.answer: Have you repaired the table yet? / No, I haven't. I'm still repairing it.

questions.prompt: 7. She started to cook the meal at five o'clock.
questions.answer: Has she cooked the meal yet? / No, she hasn't. She's still cooking it.

questions.prompt: 8. You started to repair my bike two hours ago.
questions.answer: Have you repaired my bike yet? / No, I haven't. I'm still repairing it.

questions.prompt: 9. Tim started to eat the steak some minutes ago.
questions.answer: Has Tim eaten the steak yet? / No, he hasn't. He's still eating it.

questions.prompt: 10. She started to clean her shoes ten minutes ago.
questions.answer: Has she cleaned her shoes yet? / No, she hasn't. She's still cleaning them.

questions.prompt: 11. They started to look at the pictures after lunch.
questions.answer: Have they looked at the pictures yet? / No, they haven't. They're still looking at them.

questions.prompt: 12. He started to read the newspaper an hour ago.
questions.answer: Has he read the newspaper yet? / No, he hasn't. He's still reading it.

grammar.title: III. Answer the questions according to the example. 仿照例句回答下列问题。
grammar.instruction:
Answer the questions according to the example. 仿照例句回答下列问题。
Example: 1. Have John and Mary stopped working? → John has already stopped, but Mary is still working.
grammar.translation: Answer each "Have they stopped?" question with one person having stopped and the other still doing it.
grammar.context: Item 1 is a printed example (not editable). Items 2-6 are suggested model answers following the example pattern.

questions.prompt: 1. Have John and Mary stopped working?
questions.answer: John has already stopped, but Mary is still working.

questions.prompt: 2. Have the boys and the girls stopped playing?
questions.answer: The boys have already stopped, but the girls are still playing.

questions.prompt: 3. Have Ann and Peter stopped reading?
questions.answer: Ann has already stopped, but Peter is still reading.

questions.prompt: 4. Have the men and the women stopped talking?
questions.answer: The men have already stopped, but the women are still talking.

questions.prompt: 5. Have Jane and Jill stopped listening to the stereo?
questions.answer: Jane has already stopped, but Jill is still listening.

questions.prompt: 6. Have Helen and Dave stopped running?
questions.answer: Helen has already stopped, but Dave is still running.

grammar.title: IV. Complete the dialogues, using the cues given according to the example. 仿照例句用所给的词完成下列对话。
grammar.instruction:
Complete the dialogues, using the cues given according to the example. 仿照例句用所给的词完成下列对话。
Example: 1. your friend / buy a watch / last week → Has your friend bought a watch? Yes, he has. When did he buy it? He bought it last week.
grammar.translation: Write the present-perfect question and the past-simple answer for each set of cues, following the example.
grammar.context: Item 1 is a printed example (not editable). Items 2-10 are suggested model answers following the example pattern.

questions.prompt: 1. your friend / buy a watch / last week
questions.answer: Has your friend bought a watch? / Yes, he has. / When did he buy it? / He bought it last week.

questions.prompt: 2. you / see the cat / a minute ago
questions.answer: Have you seen the cat? / Yes, I have. / When did you see it? / I saw it a minute ago.

questions.prompt: 3. they / eat the chicken / yesterday evening
questions.answer: Have they eaten the chicken? / Yes, they have. / When did they eat it? / They ate it yesterday evening.

questions.prompt: 4. she / do the housework / at about four o'clock
questions.answer: Has she done the housework? / Yes, she has. / When did she do it? / She did it at about four o'clock.

questions.prompt: 5. he / have a cigarette / two minutes ago
questions.answer: Has he had a cigarette? / Yes, he has. / When did he have one? / He had one two minutes ago.

questions.prompt: 6. they / find their books / half an hour ago
questions.answer: Have they found their books? / Yes, they have. / When did they find them? / They found them half an hour ago.

questions.prompt: 7. they / have a party / last Friday evening
questions.answer: Have they had a party? / Yes, they have. / When did they have one? / They had one last Friday evening.

questions.prompt: 8. she / go to the baker's / at nine this morning
questions.answer: Has she been to the baker's? / Yes, she has. / When did she go there? / She went there at nine this morning.

questions.prompt: 9. you / meet your new neighbours / yesterday morning
questions.answer: Have you met your new neighbours? / Yes, I have. / When did you meet them? / I met them yesterday morning.

questions.prompt: 10. Sophie / drive a Toyota / a year ago
questions.answer: Has Sophie driven a Toyota? / Yes, she has. / When did she drive one? / She drove one a year ago.
